transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I guess what brings me in is that I've just gotten so slowed down lately. I'm an auditor, and I can sit there staring at one workpaper for twenty minutes before I even move my hand to type anything. It's gotten to the point where people at work have started noticing that I'm not keeping up.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yeah, I have. Most days I wake up with this... heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It just feels like the day is already lost before I've even managed to get out of bed.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually energetic or high, unlike your usual self?
No, I haven't. I've pretty much just been feeling low. I can't think of a time where I felt unusually energetic or anything like that.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don't seem to?

Actually, yes. Um... sometimes when I open a spreadsheet or check my email, I hear a voice. It's really clear, and it sounds like it's coming from just behind my laptop. It says, "You missed it, they know." But... I'm the only one in the room when it happens.
Have you ever heard that voice during a time when you were not feeling depressed?

No, I haven't. I never heard that voice before... well, before this whole depression thing started. Same with this feeling I have that the firm is secretly building a case against me to fire me. None of that ever happened before my mood and my energy just... tanked. It all only started after I had already been feeling really low for a while.
Before this current period, have you ever had another episode in your life where you felt depressed like this for at least two weeks?

No, I haven't. I mean, I've had stressful weeks before, you know, with audits or busy seasons at work, but I've never felt like this. I've never had a time where I felt this down for weeks on end. This is really the first time it's ever gotten like this.
